timing_s.note: the horizon pass covers every drawn face because the drawing shades all of them; the irradiance pass covers only the planes a reader can select, so the two are reported per their own population rather than divided into each other

sunlight_on_roof_kwh_per_m2.note: plane-of-array irradiance over the year, not electricity

diffuse_shading_effect.note: kept with diffuse treated as unobstructed, against kept with diffuse reduced by the sky the neighbours cover

single_sample_penalty.note: bundle value minus five-sample value, on a random sample of planes; positive means the single centroid sample reports a roof as less shaded than it is
